
# Nexa

> Nexa is a digital finance and commerce platform project by Novix.

Official website: https://nexa-sd.github.io/
GitHub: https://github.com/Nexa-sd

## About

Nexa is being developed as a connected digital platform focused on digital wallets, peer-to-peer trading, and digital commerce.

## Main Areas

- Digital Wallet: Balance management and digital transactions.
- P2P Trading: Peer-to-peer trading workflows.
- Digital Marketplace: Digital products, stores, and orders.
- Digital Transfers: User-to-user transfer functionality.
- Blockchain: Planned integration with TRON, BNB Smart Chain, and Polygon.

## Technology

- Backend: Python and FastAPI.
- Database: PostgreSQL.
- Frontend: Flet.
- Infrastructure: Linux VPS.

## Organization

Novix is the technology brand behind the Nexa project.

## Project Status

Nexa is under active development. Features and integrations may change as development progresses.

For current project information, visit the official website and GitHub repository.
